lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੇਨੁ ਬਜਾਵਉਗੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: akha(n)d ma(n)dal nira(n)kaar mahi anahad ben bajaavaugo ||1||
lines.translation: In the imperishable realm of the Formless Lord, I play the flute of the unstruck sound current. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਗਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: bairaagee raamahi gaavaugo ||
lines.translation: Becoming detached, I sing the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤੀਤ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਆਕੁਲ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad ateet anaahad raataa aakul kai ghar jaaugo ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Imbued with the unattached, unstruck Word of the Shabad, I shall go to the home of the Lord, who has no ancestors. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਅਉਰੁ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਪਉਨੈ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਉਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: iRaa pi(n)gulaa aur sukhamanaa paunai ba(n)dh rahaaugo ||
lines.translation: Then, I shall no longer control the breath through the energy channels of the Ida, Pingala and Shushmanaa.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਉਗੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj dui sam kar raakhau braham jot mil jaaugo ||2||
lines.translation: I look upon both the moon and the sun as the same, and I shall merge in the Light of God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਪੈਸਉ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਨ ਸਤਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: teerath dekh na jal mahi paisau jee ja(n)t na sataavaugo ||
lines.translation: I do not go to see sacred shrines of pilgrimage, or bathe in their waters; I do not bother any beings or creatures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਨੑਾਉਗੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: athasath teerath guroo dikhaae ghat hee bheetar nhaaugo ||3||
lines.translation: The Guru has shown me the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage within my own heart, where I now take my cleansing bath. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਲੋ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕਹਾਵਉਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch sahaaee jan kee sobhaa bhalo bhalo na kahaavaugo ||
lines.translation: I do not pay attention to anyone praising me, or calling me good and nice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਉਗੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naamaa kahai chit har siu raataa su(n)n samaadh samaaugo ||4||2||
lines.translation: Says Naam Dayv, my consciousness is imbued with the Lord; I am absorbed in the profound state of Samaadhi. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਤੀ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maai na hotee baap na hotaa karam na hotee kaaiaa ||
lines.translation: When there was no mother and no father, no karma and no human body,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਤੇ ਕਵਨੁ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ham nahee hote tum nahee hote kavan kahaa(n) te aaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: when I was not and you were not, then who came from where? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam koi na kis hee keraa ||
lines.translation: O Lord, no one belongs to anyone else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਰਵਰਿ ਪੰਖਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise taravar pa(n)kh baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: We are like birds perched on a tree. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਸੂਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਪਾਨੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)d na hotaa soor na hotaa paanee pavan milaaiaa ||
lines.translation: When there was no moon and no sun, then water and air were blended together.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਬੇਦੁ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: saasat na hotaa bed na hotaa karam kahaa(n) te aaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: When there were no Shaastras and no Vedas, then where did karma come from? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਚਰ ਭੂਚਰ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: khechar bhoochar tulasee maalaa gur parasaadee paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Control of the breath and positioning of the tongue, focusing at the third eye and wearing malas of tulsi beads, are all obtained through Guru's Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naamaa pranavai param tat hai satigur hoi lakhaaiaa ||3||3||
lines.translation: Naam Dayv prays, this is the supreme essence of reality; the True Guru has inspired this realization. ||3||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਨਾਰਸੀ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੈ ਉਲਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਰੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਦਹੈ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਲਪੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: baanaarasee tap karai ulat teerath marai agan dahai kaaiaa kalap keejai ||
lines.translation: Someone may practice austerities at Benares, or die upside-down at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage, or burn his body in fire, or rejuvenate his body to live almost forever;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਮੇਧ ਜਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਸੋਨਾ ਗਰਭ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: asumedh jag keejai sonaa garabh daan deejai raam naam sar taoo na poojai ||1||
lines.translation: he may perform the horse-sacrifice ceremony, or give donations of gold covered over, but none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਰੇ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਮਨ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhod chhod re paakha(n)dee man kapat na keejai ||
lines.translation: O hypocrite, renounce and abandon your hypocrisy; do not practice deception.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam nit nitahi leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Constantly, continually, chant the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੰਗਾ ਜਉ ਗੋਦਾਵਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁੰਭਿ ਜਉ ਕੇਦਾਰ ਨੑਾਈਐ ਗੋਮਤੀ ਸਹਸ ਗਊ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ga(n)gaa jau godaavar jaaeeai ku(n)bh jau kedaar nhaaeeai gomatee sahas gaoo daan keejai ||
lines.translation: Someone may go to the Ganges or the Godaavari, or to the Kumbha festival, or bathe at Kaydaar Naat'h, or make donations of thousands of cows at Gomti;

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰੈ ਤਨੁ ਜਉ ਹਿਵਾਲੇ ਗਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kot jau teerath karai tan jau hivaale gaarai raam naam sar taoo na poojai ||2||
lines.translation: he may make millions of pilgrimages to sacred shrines, or freeze his body in the Himalayas; still, none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸੁ ਦਾਨ ਗਜ ਦਾਨ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਨਾਰੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨ ਐਸੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: as daan gaj daan sihajaa naaree bhoom daan aiso daan nit nitahi keejai ||
lines.translation: Someone may give away horses and elephants, or women on their beds, or land; he may give such gifts over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਜਉ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਪ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਤਊ ਨ ਪੂਜੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aatam jau niramaail keejai aap baraabar ka(n)chan deejai raam naam sar taoo na poojai ||3||
lines.translation: He may purify his soul, and give away in charity his body weight in gold; none of these is equal to the worship of the Lord's Name. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਰੋਸੁ ਜਮਹਿ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨੑਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manahi na keejai ros jamahi na deejai dos niramal nirabaan pad cheenhi leejai ||
lines.translation: Do not harbor anger in your mind, or blame the Messenger of Death; instead, realize the immaculate state of Nirvaanaa.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਸਰਥ ਰਾਇ ਨੰਦੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਚੰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ਤਤੁ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jasarath raai na(n)d raajaa meraa raam cha(n)d pranavai naamaa tat ras a(n)mrit peejai ||4||4||
lines.translation: My Sovereign Lord King is Raam Chandra, the Son of the King Dasrat'h; prays Naam Dayv, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee baanee ravidaas jee kee ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਨੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਅਨਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਦਰਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paReeai guneeai naam sabh suneeai anabhau bhaau na darasai ||
lines.translation: They read and reflect upon all the Names of God; they listen, but they do not see the Lord, the embodiment of love and intuition.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਾ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹਿਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਉ ਪਾਰਸਹਿ ਨ ਪਰਸੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: lohaa ka(n)chan hiran hoi kaise jau paarasahi na parasai ||1||
lines.translation: How can iron be transformed into gold, unless it touches the Philosopher's Stone? ||1||
